name.zh: 一辉抱病赢下第十八战
name.en: Ikki Wins His Eighteenth Match While Ill

periods.location: League Japan Branch simulated battlefield; Hagun front gate aftermath
periods.summary: Ikki wins another selection match at the League facility, but Oreki returns to Hagun and tells Shizuku and Alice that he looked seriously ill and coughed throughout the battle.
periods.cause: Kurono arranges for Ikki's selection matches to continue despite Ethics Committee confinement.
periods.process: Oreki attends as the school-side teacher and observes symptoms suggesting more than a simple cold. She tells Shizuku only enough to explain that Ikki won but is unwell.
periods.outcome: Shizuku and Alice suspect the Ethics Committee may be doing something to Ikki but cannot reach him.
periods.significance: Shows Ikki's physical deterioration and the growing concern among allies.
